name: fynns-ui-consume
title: Install @fynns/ui via git submodule (LLM contract)
description: Machine-readable API for agents: add fynns_ui_design_core as a submodule and wire Vite/tsconfig aliases. Never npm-install this package. Short user prompts still require reading this contract before UI work.
rules: On any short prompt involving @fynns/ui / fynns UI / Collapsible (etc.), read llm/CONSUME.md before writing app code.
Consume as git submodule + Vite source alias @fynns/ui.
NEVER add @fynns/ui or @fynns/ui-design-core to package.json dependencies/devDependencies.
NEVER publish-install from npm registry for day-to-day app work.
Keep resolve.dedupe [react, react-dom] so submodule source shares the app React instance.
Do not modify files inside packages/fynns_ui_design_core from consumer feature work (bump pin separately).
Consumer tsconfig compilerOptions.target and lib must be ES2022 or later (tsc follows @fynns/ui into design-system sources; ES2020 fails on APIs such as String.replaceAll).
Do not import purged symbols (toast/Toaster/Dialog/Popover/UnitStack/…). See llm/BREAKING_PURGE.md. Use snackbar + SnackbarHost for transient feedback.
App entry must createRoot and render App (CSS-only main.tsx is a fail).
Never hand-roll Collapsible chrome or use @radix-ui/* / sonner.
If build uses tsc, add vite-env.d.ts with /// <reference types="vite/client" /> so CSS imports from @fynns/ui typecheck.
For preview/playground pages, mirror examples/sandbox/src/pages/*PreviewCanvas.tsx and skim AGENTS.md.

bootstrapThenInstall.description: When the consumer does not yet have this repo: clone core to a temp dir, then run install against the consumer root.

install.description: Add submodule (if missing) and wire Vite + tsconfig. Run from a checkout of fynns_ui_design_core.

check.description: Validate submodule + alias + no forbidden npm deps.

wireOnly.description: Submodule already present; only patch Vite/tsconfig.

successCriteria: vite.config.* has resolve.alias["@fynns/ui"] pointing at that entry
vite resolve.dedupe includes react and react-dom
tsconfig paths map @fynns/ui to the same entry (when a tsconfig exists)
tsconfig target/lib are ES2022+ when the consumer runs tsc against @fynns/ui
package.json does not depend on @fynns/ui or @fynns/ui-design-core
import { Collapsible } from "@fynns/ui" typechecks / builds in the consumer
no imports of purged symbols listed in llm/BREAKING_PURGE.md
